source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第二册 Unit 1 Using language:Future continuous(will be doing)。句子地道、成长主题、答案唯一(选项排除其他成立项)。

points.point: 将来进行时表将来某一时刻正在进行的动作
points.overview: 句中有 this time tomorrow / at 8 tonight / while you are… 等"将来某一点"或"同时进行"标志时,表示那一刻"正在进行"的持续性动作,用 will be doing(而非一次性完成的 will do)。

points.point: 将来进行时 vs 一般将来时(进行中 vs 整体完成)
points.overview: 强调将来某时"正进行/作背景"的持续动作用 will be doing;表示"承诺/决定/条件结果/一次性完成"的整体动作用 will do。由语境判断填哪一种。

points.point: 将来进行时表委婉询问 / 预期中自然发生的将来
points.overview: 用 Will you be doing…? 礼貌、客观地询问对方既定安排(不含请求/施压);用 I'll be doing… 表示"按常规、顺理成章"会发生的将来,而非临时的意愿或决定。

questions.stem: "This time tomorrow, I ____ my driving test, so please wish me luck!"
questions.explanation: this time tomorrow 指将来某一时刻、考试正在进行 → will be taking。

questions.stem: "Don't call me at eight tonight — I ____ dinner with my family then."
questions.explanation: at eight tonight 那一刻正在吃饭,持续动作 → will be having。

questions.stem: "While you are lying on the beach next week, I ____ hard for my final exams."
questions.explanation: while you are lying… 表两动作同时进行 → will be studying。

questions.stem: "At noon tomorrow, the new graduates ____ across the stage to collect their certificates."
questions.explanation: at noon tomorrow 那一刻正走过舞台 → will be walking。

questions.stem: "This time next year, I ____ at a university far away from home."
questions.explanation: this time next year 指将来某点正在进行 → will be studying。

questions.stem: "At ten o'clock tonight, the night train ____ us towards the capital."
questions.explanation: at ten tonight 那一刻列车正载着我们 → will be carrying。

questions.stem: "When you arrive at the airport tomorrow, I ____ for you near the gate."
questions.explanation: when you arrive 那一刻我正在等 → will be waiting。

questions.stem: "This time tomorrow morning, the whole class ____ their final exam papers."
questions.explanation: this time tomorrow morning 那一刻正在写 → will be writing。

questions.stem: "At this moment next week, we ____ over the Pacific on our way to Australia."
questions.explanation: at this moment next week 那一刻正在飞行 → will be flying。

questions.stem: "Don't visit me at three this afternoon — I ____ a nap after the long journey."
questions.explanation: at three 那一刻正在午睡 → will be having。

questions.stem: "While my parents are at work tomorrow, I ____ online for my own apartment."
questions.explanation: while my parents are at work 表同时进行 → will be searching。

questions.stem: "At eight tomorrow evening, she ____ her organ donation form at the hospital."
questions.explanation: at eight tomorrow evening 那一刻正在签 → will be signing。

questions.stem: "This time on Saturday, the volunteers ____ trees in the city park."
questions.explanation: this time on Saturday 那一刻正在植树 → will be planting。

questions.stem: "When the clock strikes midnight, we ____ in the New Year together."
questions.explanation: when the clock strikes midnight 那一刻正在迎接 → will be welcoming。

questions.stem: "At lunchtime tomorrow, the new librarian ____ books onto the shelves."
questions.explanation: at lunchtime tomorrow 那一刻正在整理 → will be arranging。

questions.stem: "While you are still sleeping, the early bus ____ me to my first day at work."
questions.explanation: while you are sleeping 表同时进行 → will be taking。

questions.stem: "This time tomorrow, the graduates ____ goodbye to the campus they love."
questions.explanation: this time tomorrow 那一刻正在道别 → will be saying。

questions.stem: "At seven tonight, I ____ to my grandfather about my plans for the future."
questions.explanation: at seven tonight 那一刻正在交谈 → will be talking。

questions.stem: "When you wake up tomorrow, I ____ on a train towards my new job."
questions.explanation: when you wake up 那一刻我正在路上 → will be travelling。

questions.stem: "At this time next month, he ____ in his very own rented flat."
questions.explanation: at this time next month 指将来某点持续居住 → will be living。

questions.stem: "Don't phone me at nine tonight — I ____ my favourite show then."
questions.explanation: at nine then 那一刻正在看,强调进行 → will be watching。

questions.stem: "This time tomorrow we ____ for our final exams, so we really can't meet up."
questions.explanation: this time tomorrow 那一刻正在复习 → will be revising。

questions.stem: "At six this evening the volunteers ____ the hall for the leavers' party."
questions.explanation: at six this evening 那一刻正在布置,进行中 → will be decorating。

questions.stem: "While the others are sleeping, I ____ quietly in the library."
questions.explanation: while the others are sleeping 表同时进行 → will be studying。

questions.stem: "Don't worry about me at noon — I ____ lunch with my new classmates then."
questions.explanation: at noon then 那一刻正在吃饭 → will be having。

questions.stem: "When you call at eight, the children ____ their homework upstairs."
questions.explanation: when you call at eight 那一刻正在做作业 → will be doing。

questions.stem: "This time on Sunday, Grandpa ____ his calligraphy as he always does."
questions.explanation: this time on Sunday 那一刻正在练字 → will be practising。

questions.stem: "Don't expect a quick reply at three — I ____ my driving test then."
questions.explanation: at three then 那一刻正在考试 → will be taking。

questions.stem: "While you are at work, the movers ____ my things into the new flat."
questions.explanation: while you are at work 表同时进行 → will be carrying。

questions.stem: "At this time tomorrow, the band ____ on the main stage of the festival."
questions.explanation: at this time tomorrow 那一刻正在演奏 → will be playing。

questions.stem: "I promise I ____ the household bills as soon as I get my first wage."
questions.explanation: I promise… 是承诺、一次性完成动作 → 一般将来 will pay。

questions.stem: "If you lend me the money now, I ____ it back to you next month."
questions.explanation: 条件句结果、整体完成的归还动作 → will give。

questions.stem: "The moment I turn eighteen, I ____ for a driving licence straight away."
questions.explanation: the moment… straight away 一次性完成的决定动作 → will apply。

questions.stem: "Don't worry — I ____ you the moment I reach the dormitory tonight."
questions.explanation: the moment I reach… 一次性完成的动作 → will text。

questions.stem: "I've finally decided that next year I ____ an organ donation form."
questions.explanation: I've decided 表决定、整体完成的一次动作 → will sign。

questions.stem: "If it rains tomorrow, we ____ the graduation party indoors instead."
questions.explanation: 条件句结果、整体安排 → will hold。

questions.stem: "She is certain that hard work ____ her dream come true one day."
questions.explanation: 对结果的预测、整体完成 → will make。

questions.stem: "Give me one week, and I ____ back every cent that I borrowed."
questions.explanation: 承诺、一次性完成的归还 → will pay。

questions.stem: "Once the exams are over, I ____ a part-time job for the summer."
questions.explanation: once… 表整体完成的将来动作 → will find。

questions.stem: "I'm sure you ____ the right decision when the time finally comes."
questions.explanation: 对未来整体动作的预测 → will make。

questions.stem: "____ the computer this evening? If not, may I borrow it for my homework?"
questions.explanation: 委婉询问对方既定安排、不含请求 → Will you be using。

questions.stem: "____ past the post office on your way home? I just need one stamp."
questions.explanation: 客观询问对方行程安排 → Will you be going。

questions.stem: "____ the car tomorrow, Dad? I'd like to drive to the library if it's free."
questions.explanation: 礼貌打听对方是否需要、不施压 → Will you be needing。

questions.stem: "____ in this seat much longer? I'm waiting for somewhere to sit."
questions.explanation: 委婉询问对方安排 → Will you be staying。

questions.stem: "____ to the graduation party on Friday? I can easily give you a lift."
questions.explanation: 客观询问对方计划 → Will you be coming。

questions.stem: "____ the photocopier for long? I have just a single page to print."
questions.explanation: 礼貌询问对方占用安排 → Will you be using。

questions.stem: "____ your headphones tonight? I'd love to borrow them for the train."
questions.explanation: 委婉打听对方安排 → Will you be wearing。

questions.stem: "____ the kitchen soon? I'd like to start cooking dinner if you've finished."
questions.explanation: 客观询问对方占用计划 → Will you be using。

questions.stem: "____ at home this evening? I might drop by with the documents."
questions.explanation: 委婉询问对方既定安排 → Will you be working。

questions.stem: "____ the meeting room after lunch? Our study group needs a quiet space."
questions.explanation: 礼貌打听对方安排 → Will you be using。

questions.stem: "I ____ Lin Ning at the library tomorrow anyway, so I'll pass on your message."
questions.explanation: anyway 表顺理成章会发生的将来,非临时意愿 → will be seeing。

questions.stem: "Don't make a special trip — I ____ past your house this afternoon in any case."
questions.explanation: in any case 表本就会发生的将来 → will be driving。

questions.stem: "Ask Tom yourself; I ____ him at training later today as usual."
questions.explanation: as usual 表按常规自然会发生 → will be meeting。

questions.stem: "Leave the books with me — I ____ to the library tomorrow anyway."
questions.explanation: anyway 表本就要去 → will be going。

questions.stem: "There's no need to wait up; we ____ home quite late after the ceremony."
questions.explanation: 顺理成章会发生的将来情形 → will be getting。

questions.stem: "Don't bother posting it; I ____ the office tomorrow and can hand it in myself."
questions.explanation: 表本就安排好的将来行程 → will be visiting。

questions.stem: "I ____ my grandparents this weekend in any case, so I'll deliver the gift."
questions.explanation: in any case 表顺理成章的将来 → will be visiting。

questions.stem: "She ____ through the city centre on her way to work, so she can pick it up."
questions.explanation: 表本就会发生的将来情形 → will be passing。

questions.stem: "I ____ near the station later this evening, so I can easily collect your parcel."
questions.explanation: later 表顺路、自然会发生的将来 → will be walking。

questions.stem: "We ____ dinner at six as usual, so do join us if you happen to be free."
questions.explanation: as usual 表按常规进行的将来情形 → will be having。
